home.title: PolySport
home.subtitle: Multi-Agent Debate × Knowledge Graph × On-Chain Smart Money — AI Sports Prediction Engine
home.hero_detail: PolySport deploys 7 AI analyst agents — each with distinct cognitive biases — to debate every NBA matchup across 2 structured rounds. By fusing real-time stats from the NBA API, Polymarket prediction market odds, and on-chain smart money wallet data into a unified knowledge graph, the system produces layered moneyline, spread, and total predictions you can act on with confidence.
home.step1_desc: We pull real-time team and player stats from the NBA API, fetch live prediction market odds from Polymarket, and track on-chain smart money wallets to capture informed conviction signals before tip-off.
home.step2_desc: All collected data feeds into a structured NBA ontology with 10 entity types and 8 relation types — teams, players, injuries, matchup history, and more — stored in Zep's graph memory for contextual retrieval.
home.step3_desc: 7 specialized AI analysts — Stats, Betting, Injury, Tactical, Momentum, Home Court, and Smart Money — debate across 2 rounds (14 LLM calls total), challenging each other's reasoning to surface blind spots.
home.step4_desc: After debate, PolySport aggregates analyst positions into a weighted consensus and outputs layered predictions: L1 betting card, L2 key factors and confidence breakdown, and L3 full debate transcript.
home.footer_cta_text: Ready to predict the next game with AI?
home.faq_1_a: PolySport is an AI-powered sports prediction engine that combines multi-agent debate, knowledge graphs, and on-chain smart money data from Polymarket to predict NBA game outcomes — moneyline, spread, and totals.
home.faq_2_a: PolySport maintains a public verified track record. Moneyline hit rates typically exceed 90%, with spread and totals accuracy above 65%. All results are verified against actual NBA game outcomes.
home.faq_3_a: We combine real-time NBA API data (team stats, player performance, injury reports), Polymarket prediction market odds, and on-chain smart money wallet tracking for comprehensive game analysis.
home.faq_4_a: PolySport uses 7 specialized AI analyst agents — each with unique cognitive biases — who debate across 2 rounds. This structured mechanism produces a weighted consensus prediction rather than relying on a single model.
home.faq_5_a: On-chain smart money refers to tracking high-performing wallets on Polymarket's blockchain-based prediction market. PolySport analyzes their position sizing, entry timing, and directional bets to gauge informed conviction on game outcomes.
home.faq_6_a: PolySport offers a free tier with limited daily predictions. For unlimited access, advanced analytics, and priority processing, we offer monthly subscription plans. Visit the Account page after logging in to view available plans.
home.faq_7_q: How does the knowledge graph work?
home.faq_7_a: PolySport's knowledge graph models the NBA domain with 10 entity types (teams, players, games, injuries, standings, etc.) and 8 relation types (plays_for, injured_in, matchup_history, etc.). This structured representation enables analysts to reason over complex relationships rather than flat statistics.
home.faq_8_q: What sports will PolySport support next?
home.faq_8_a: We are actively building coverage for the English Premier League (EPL) and FIFA World Cup 2026. The same multi-agent debate architecture will be adapted with sport-specific ontologies, data sources, and analyst roles for each league.

stats_analyst.name: Stats Analyst
stats_analyst.desc: Focuses on advanced metrics (Net Rating, TS%, etc.), over-relies on data and dismisses intangibles

betting_expert.name: Betting Expert
betting_expert.desc: Focuses on market line movement and sharp money, contrarian thinker who fades public consensus

injury_analyst.name: Injury Analyst
injury_analyst.desc: Focuses on player health and rotation depth, overestimates injury impact on game outcomes

tactical_analyst.name: Tactical Analyst
tactical_analyst.desc: Focuses on positional matchups and scheme fit, over-reads tactical advantages over raw talent

momentum_analyst.name: Momentum Analyst
momentum_analyst.desc: Focuses on recent form and streaks, severe recency bias weighing last 3-5 games heavily

home_court_analyst.name: Home Court Analyst
home_court_analyst.desc: Focuses on home/away splits and travel fatigue, overestimates home court as decisive factor

smart_money_analyst.name: Smart Money Analyst
smart_money_analyst.desc: Tracks on-chain smart money positions on Polymarket, analyzes entry timing and position sizing to gauge informed conviction
